requirement: S39 guided tour current-source recheck after module-target refresh
scope: Source review against the existing Sol contract; does not claim independent Sol acceptance.

contractChecks.roleAndPrivacy: Base steps are available by role; request/quality, manager analytics/team, and jefe-only closure/catalogue steps are conditionally included. The annotations step points to the user's own action/library and its copy states that the tour does not reveal note contents.
contractChecks.targetsAndFallbacks: Current step selectors exist in App or their owning modules, including empty-state fallbacks. Folded panels and native details are opened temporarily; manual user toggles are recorded and preserved when the tour restores state.
contractChecks.viewportAndMotion: Target scroll respects prefers-reduced-motion, recalculates on resize and scroll, and coach coordinates clamp to the viewport. CSS disables animation, transitions, and smooth scrolling under reduced motion.
contractChecks.keyboardAndFocus: Escape pauses; Tab and Shift+Tab are contained in the coach. Closing restores the initiating element when still valid, otherwise the current tour trigger. Changing actor closes the tour before stale actor content is retained.
contractChecks.noBusinessMutation: Tour actions only change tour progress, route, focus, and temporary presentation state; no submission or business confirmation is wired to the steps. Existing tests assert the tour does not seed tasks.

runtimeEvidence.result: 31/31 Edge checks passed; employee/manager/boss tours had 11/13/15 steps; desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844; 0 JavaScript errors and 0 operational API calls.

result: No source-level mismatch found in the inspected S39 contract; no product code correction was warranted.
limits: This does not replace the independent GPT-6.1 Sol review.
